undocumentedDifferences.detail: validateReviewPayload returns {model, state, questions}; the playground validatePayload returns {state, model, questions}. JSON object member order carries no meaning, but the serialized bodies are not byte-identical. The prior record's normalizedV1RequestsIdentical holds because it normalizes through each validator and a JSON round trip; it does not claim byte identity.
